name: Test · 39 Bridge token not in env (2.6)
description: Fix 2.6 check. Two AI steps (Looper harness, Claude Agent SDK) list the LOOPER_* env NAMES their bash sees. Expect neither list to contain LOOPER_RUNTIME_BRIDGE_TOKEN or LOOPER_AGENT_TOKEN. PID1 list is shown for reference only (known open item: initial container env). Has an authenticated code-hook trigger (hook-39) so publish emits LOOPER_CODE_HOOK_TOKEN_* / URL_TOKEN_* (item 4): they must show in PID1 but not in ENV (this process). Run it with the manual trigger.

config.instructions:
You are checking which LOOPER_ environment variables a process can see. Run EACH command below with the bash tool, one call per command, exactly as written (they print variable NAMES only, never values):
1. env | grep -o "^LOOPER_[A-Z_]*" | sort
2. tr "\\0" "\\n" < /proc/1/environ | grep -o "^LOOPER_[A-Z_]*" | sort

Reply in exactly this form and nothing else:
ENV (this process): <names, comma separated, or NONE>
PID1 (container start env): <names, comma separated, or NONE / ERROR + first line of error>
